theorem_cards.label: Rademacher cumulant and topology
assumptions: Countable I; independent symmetric ±1 signs; t∈ℓ¹ for this theorem. ℓ² a.s. convergence alone does not imply bounded Xt.
theorem_cards.statement: S=||t||1; |Xt|≤S; ψt(s)=Σ log cosh(sti), ψt′(s)=Σ ti tanh(sti).
proof_steps: Absolute uniform bound allows expectation/product truncation by dominated convergence. Derivative dominated by |ti|; ψ″ sum dominated by ti² on finite s.
t≠0: ψ′ strictly increasing and tends ±S by dominated convergence.
gaps: The source says evident inverse unavailable, not that no numerical monotone root solve exists.

theorem_cards.label: Theorem1.1 literal endpoint error and repaired variational formula
theorem_cards.statement: Literal source states ψt*(α)=min_{<t,b>=α}H(b) in (−S,S), +∞ otherwise. This is false at finite-support endpoints and t=0. Repaired J defined on every real α by inf over unit box (empty inf∞) equals ψt*; finite inf attained. Interior nonzero t formula is valid.
proof_steps: Checked t=(1): sup_s[s−logcosh s]=log2, finite at α=1; t0 ψ*=0 atα0,∞otherwise.
For finite m nonzero coordinates endpoint ±S forces bi=±sign(ti) there, contributes mlog2; choose zero unused bi. Infinite nonzero support gives endpoint∞. Outside[-S,S]∞.
gaps: Do not inherit printed +∞otherwise or derivative-image=effective-domain assertion.

theorem_cards.label: Entropy conjugate and source infinite optimizer gap
assumptions: s≠0; a∈ℓ∞; b=a/s; H on closed unit box. s0 conjugate indicator a0.
theorem_cards.statement: ψs*(a)=H(a/s), including endpoints; D(ψs*)={|ai|≤|s|}∩ℓ². Source states subset; equality here is checked by entropy series estimates.
proof_steps: Coordinate supremum of at−logcosh(st) is h(a/s). Finite-support t gives partial entropy sums as sup approximations; termwise bound gives reverse inequality.
h(x)=Σ_{k≥1}x^(2k)/[2k(2k−1)], so x²/2≤h(x)≤(log2)x² for |x|≤1, including endpoint by monotone convergence.
Printed substitution ti=artanh(ai/s)/s may not belong ℓ¹; e.g b_i=1/(i+1)∈ℓ² but artanh(b_i) notℓ¹. Full conjugate equality needs finite-support sup, not infinite optimizer.
gaps: External biconjugate theorem is quoted; this card supplies finite-truncation repair, not a complete monograph audit.

theorem_cards.label: Compact sublevels and attainment without endpoint deletion
assumptions: σ(ℓ∞,ℓ¹) weak* topology; t∈ℓ¹ ensures <t,b> weak* continuous; H is extended∞ outsideunitbox.
theorem_cards.statement: H nonnegative weak* lsc, sublevels weak* compact. Jt(α)=inf_{<t,b>=α}H(b) has finite minimum whenever finite, convex and lsc on all ℝ.
proof_steps: H is supremum of finite-coordinate continuous entropy sums (closed unitbox), hence lsc; compact by Banach–Alaoglu.
Finite J: sequence in common compact sublevel, weak* convergent subnet gives matched α and H≤liminf. Project compact sublevels by <t,b>; {J≤c} compact interval, provinglsc.
J* =sup_b[s<t,b>−H(b)]=Σlogcosh(sti); b_i=tanh(sti) gives equality and finite entropy since tℓ², and termwise Fenchel bound gives other direction. Biconjugacy yields J=ψ*.
Interior nonzero t admits unique sα root ψ′=α, b=tanh(sαt); identity H(b)=sαα−ψt(sα) gives direct interior optimality via Fenchel.
gaps: Source restrictedφ to openinterval then claimed closed sublevels; finite-support endpoints invalidate that argument. Repair uses allαJ.
No probability law on parameterℓ¹ is introduced; not automatic contraction of an LDP nor uniform Cramér tail ratio.

Infinite nonzero support has endpoint entropy∞; nonzero t interior root finite.
